title: Tanzanian Cardamom Biscuits
community: Zanzibar and coastal Tanzania — the spiced biscuit with chai
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Biskuti ya Iliki — crisp, buttery cardamom biscuits perfumed with Zanzibar cardamom, lightly sweet and perfect with chai. The biscuit that accompanies every important conversation on the Swahili coast.
longDesc: Cardamom biscuits are the biscuit of Zanzibar's tea culture — served with every cup of spiced tea at every gathering, these crisp, buttery, heavily cardamom-scented biscuits are the social lubricant of the coast. They should taste more of cardamom than anything else.
steps: Combine flour, icing sugar, cardamom, nutmeg, and salt.
Rub cold butter into flour until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add egg yolk and water. Mix until dough just comes together.
Roll to 5mm thickness. Cut into rounds or desired shapes.
Place on parchment-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if using.
Bake at 170°C for 16—18 minutes until pale golden.
chefTips: Use generously more cardamom than feels necessary — these biscuits should be assertively spiced.
Cold butter is essential for a crisp, short texture.
Do not over-bake — pale golden is correct; deep golden means too hard.
commonMistakes: Warm butter — produces a greasy, not crisp result.
cookingScience: The rubbing-in technique creates a 'short' pastry — the fat coats the flour particles, preventing gluten development. When baked, the fat melts and the biscuit shatters into the characteristic crisp, crumbly texture of a shortbread biscuit. Icing sugar (finer than caster) produces a smoother texture because it dissolves completely.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar cardamom — the island's own crop.
healthBenefits: Best enjoyed as an occasional treat.
culturalNote: Cardamom biscuits are the biscuit of the Zanzibar gathering — every tea served to a guest is accompanied by these. The cardamom is non-negotiable; it is the island's most abundant spice and its presence in everything from the biryani to the biscuit is the coast's most consistent culinary signature.
